title: Input-head advance of the advice machine
statement: Let $w$ be a finite bit string, let $q,q'$ be states among four states, and let $i<|w|$. If the bit at position $i$ is $v$ and the transition of the fixed advice-ones machine from $q$ on input bit $v$ is the action that moves to state $q'$, then one step from state $q$ with its input head at position $i+1$ yields the configuration with state $q'$ and input head at position $i+2$.
hypotheses_covered: the transition on $v$ in state $q$ is the action that moves to $q'$
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the advice-ones machine, so its role can only be identified descriptively.
